integrity: The boundary convergence and critical amplitudes follow from entropy dissipation and a stable ratio equation. Stationary threshold bookkeeping and strictly positive coexistence convergence are attributed. Historical priority is literature-bounded.
scientific_limitations: One abiotic resource, fixed full local isolation, positive deterministic parameters and strictly ordered break-even concentrations; all strictly positive initial states. Does not cover stochasticity, adaptive isolation, repeated break-even concentrations, or nonlinear uptake. Related older chemostat works were not all accessible in full.
title: Global boundary convergence and critical extinction amplitudes in a fully separated consumer-resource model
